title: CramerGAN Energy Distance on 3x3 Overlapping Mixture
intuition: Tests two-sample unbiased energy-distance adversarial learning on a 9-mode 3x3 overlapping heterogeneous-mass 2D Gaussian mixture (weights 0.06 to 0.18), requiring 9/9 modes, low energy distance (<= 0.06), and non-collapsed covariance.
failure_mode: Biased mini-batch gradients or weak multi-scale critics under-cover the lighter 6%-8% peripheral modes or distort overlapping shoulders.
